page.layout: One page of text, one column. No margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Glosses run in continuous paragraphs, with German words in black letter.

main_text.p: Pelvis,ein fußbecken. Magudaris vel magydaris,meisterwurz. Mephitis,ein starcker gestanck auß der erden oder dem wasser. Ravis,henserkeit[?]. Sitis,der durst. Tussis,der husten[?]. Et Propria plæraq;: ut, Fabaris,ein fluß. Tyberis,ein fluß/fleußt durch Rom. Leucaspis,einer von den gejellt Aeneæ[?]. Opis,eine wassergöttin.
Græca sæpe pro im capiunt in: ut, Syrtis,ein gefärlich ort im Meer/pro Syrtim,habet Syrtin.
Febris,das kalte vnd warme wehe. Navis,ein schiff. Puppis,das hinderteil des schiffs. Restis,ein seil oder strick. Securis,ein Axt. Turris,ein thurn/em vel im habent.

head.i: Quænam habent in Ablativo singulari i tantum?

main_text.p: Primò, Adjectiva in er, aut is, quorum neutra in e desinunt: ut, Alacer, alacris, alacre, ab hoc alacri. Dulcis,dulce,ab hoc dulci.

Secundò,Mensium nomina in er,aut is: ut,September,Septembri,im Herbstmonat. October,Octobri,im Weinmonat. November,Novembri,im Wintermonat. December,Decembri,im Christmonat. Aprilis,Aprili,im Aprilmonat[?]. Quintilis,Quintili,im Hornmonat. Sextilis,Sextili,im Augstmonat.

Tertiò, quæ Accusatiuum singularem in im,vel in tantum formant: ut, hunc Aqualim, ab hoc Aquali. Hanc Neapolin,hac Neapoli,von der Newstatt. Canalis,Mugilis,Natalis,Rivalis,Strigilis,habent etiam i tantum in Ablativo.
Anguis, Febris, Ignis, Imber,Navis,Puppis,Restis, Securis,Turris,Unguis,Vectis,habent e vel i.
In ium: ut, Linter,lintrium. Collis,collium. Mensis,mensium. Auris,aurium. Excipe, Vates,vatum. Juvenis,juvenum. Canis,canum. Panis,panum. Volu-cris,

page.notes: Black letter German glosses are marked with bl; some forms are uncertain and marked [?]. Ravis, Tussis, Leucaspis, Aprilmonat: letters doubtful. Hyphen "Winter-" and "Volu-" are printed line-end hyphens. Dark ink stain on the M of GRAMMATICA in the running head; no catchword or signature printed.
